import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0077 (a b c : Nat) (h1 : a ∣ b) (h2 : b ∣ c) : ∀ (k l : Nat), a ∣ (k * b + l * c) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0077 (a b c : Nat) (h1 : a ∣ b) (h2 : b ∣ c) : ∀ (k l : Nat), a ∣ (k * b + l * c) := by
  intro k l
  have h3 : ∃ (m : Nat), b = m * a := by
    from h1.exists
  have h4 : ∃ (n : Nat), c = n * b := by
    from h2.exists
  obtain m : Nat, m * a = b := by
    from h3.1
  obtain n : Nat, n * b = c := by
    from h4.1
  have h5 : k * b + l * c = k * (m * a) + l * (n * b) := by
    rw [this, this]
  have h6 : k * b + l * c = (k * m + l * n) * a := by
    ring
  exact h6
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0077 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0077 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0077

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0077
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0077
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
